BiblicalUsage: Zara names the loathing that rises in the throat, the disgust that makes food itself turn against you. In Numbers 11:20 God tells the complaining Israelites that the quails they craved will become loathsome to them, meat coming out of their nostrils until they hate it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that craving without gratitude turns even a gift into something sickening, and God lets Israel taste exactly what they demanded.
